blocks.text: Yeh chapter 9 (Human Digestive System) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
9.1 Anatomy and physiology of the digestive system

blocks.prompt:
1 Why is efficient digestion vital for sustaining life?
(Achha hazma zindagi qaim rakhne ke liye kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hazma ghiza ko energy aur barhne, marammat aur dekh bhaal ke maadde mein badalta hai. Yeh immune system ko sahara aur zaroori ghizai ajza deta hai; achha hazma ghizai kami se bachata, metabolism ko sahara deta aur energy qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Efficient digestion prevents nutrient deficiencies, supports metabolism and maintains energy levels

blocks.prompt:
2 Differentiate between the GI tract and the accessory digestive organs.
(GI tract aur accessory digestive organs mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Insaani digestive system in do hisson se bana hai.

book_ref.quote: The human digestive system is composed of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract and accessory digestive organs

rows: Mounh se anus tak musalsal naali
Naali se bahar ke aaza jo hazme mein madad dete hain
Oral cavity, pharynx, oesophagus, stomach, small aur large intestine
Salivary glands, liver, gallbladder aur pancreas

blocks.prompt:
3 Give the structure and two functions of lips.
(Honton ki banawat aur do kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hont khoon ki naaliyon se bharpoor skeletal muscle se bane hain jin mein bohat se hissi nerve endings hain. Yeh chabate waqt ghiza rokte hain aur phonation (awaz ki tabdeeli) mein kirdar ada karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Lips help to retain food as it is being chewed

blocks.prompt:
4 How is food selected in the oral cavity?
(Oral cavity mein ghiza ka intikhab kaise hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zabaan taste buds se ghiza chakhti hai aur ghiza ko mehsoos kiya jata hai. Agar zaiqa ya boo na-pasand ho ya haddi ya mitti jaisi sakht cheez ho to ghiza rad kar di jati hai. Soonghna aur dekhna bhi intikhab mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: If the taste or smell is unpleasant or if hard objects like bone or dirt are present in the food, it is rejected

blocks.prompt:
5 What is mastication? Why is it important?
(Mastication kya hai? Yeh kyun ahem hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mastication (chabana) daanton se ghiza ka jismani tootna hai. Yeh ghiza ko chhote, sambhalne layak tukron mein karta hai aur enzymes ke liye satah barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Chewing reduces food into smaller and more manageable pieces, increasing the surface area for enzymatic action

blocks.prompt:
6 Name the three pairs of salivary glands and give the location of each.
(Salivary glands ke teen joron ke naam aur jagah likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Sublingual glands: zabaan ke neeche. Submaxillary glands: jabron ke peeche. Parotid glands: kaanon ke saamne.

book_ref.quote: submaxillary glands located behind jaws

blocks.prompt:
7 Differentiate between the roles of bicarbonate ions and thiocyanate ions of saliva.
(Saliva ke bicarbonate ions aur thiocyanate ions ke kaam mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono saliva ke ions hain jo paani, mucus aur salivary amylase ke saath hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Saliva also contains bicarbonate ions, which buffer chemicals in the oral cavity

rows: Oral cavity mein chemicals ko buffer karte hain
Jaraseem maarte hain

blocks.prompt:
8 During swallowing, how is the entry of food into the nasal cavity prevented?
(Nigalte waqt ghiza ko naak ki khala mein jane se kaise roka jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zabaan mounh ki chhat ki taraf upar aur peeche jati hai aur bolus ko peeche dhakelti hai, aur soft palate pharynx ki pichli deewar se lag jata hai. Yeh harkat naak ki khala aur pharynx ka rasta band kar deti hain.

book_ref.quote: These movements close the passage between nasal cavity and pharynx

blocks.prompt:
9 Is swallowing voluntary or involuntary? Explain.
(Nigalna ikhtiyari hai ya ghair-ikhtiyari? Wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono. Shuruat, yani bolus ko mounh ke peeche dhakelna, ikhtiyari hai; ghiza mounh ke peeche pohanch jaye to nigalna khud-ba-khud ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: once the food reaches the back of the mouth, swallowing becomes automatic

blocks.prompt:
10 Give two functions of the cardiac sphincter.
(Cardiac sphincter ke do kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cardiac (lower oesophageal) sphincter oesophagus se stomach mein ghiza ka jana control karta hai aur ghiza ke dabao par khulta hai. Yeh stomach ki cheezon ko oesophagus mein wapas aane se bhi rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: which opens in response to the pressure exerted by food

blocks.prompt:
11 Differentiate between peristalsis and segmentation.
(Peristalsis aur segmentation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono alimentary canal ki harkat hain.

book_ref.quote: Peristalsis squeezes the food down along oesophagus and other parts of the alimentary canal

rows: Deewaron ki smooth muscles ke sukarne ki lehrein
Smooth muscle ke challe baar baar sukarte aur dheele hote hain
Ghiza ko oesophagus aur naali mein aage dhakelti hai
Aik hi jagah aage peeche harkat
Ghiza aage barhati hai
Ghiza ko ratoobaton se milati hai; jazb behtar karti hai
Poori alimentary canal mein
Small aur large intestine mein

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between antiperistalsis and hunger contractions.
(Antiperistalsis aur hunger contractions mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono peristaltic harkat ki khaas shaklein hain.

book_ref.quote: creating the uncomfortable sensation known as hunger pangs

rows: Peristalsis ulti chalti hai
Khoon mein kam glucose se peristaltic harkat
Ghiza intestines se wapas stomach aur mounh mein
Bhook ki takleef (hunger pangs) ka ehsaas
Ulti hoti hai
Bhook mehsoos hoti hai

blocks.prompt:
13 Name the three portions of the stomach and give the position of each.
(Stomach ke teen hisson ke naam aur jagah likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Cardiac hissa: oesophagus ke foran baad. Fundus hissa: cardiac hisse ke aik taraf. Pyloric hissa: cardiac hisse ke neeche.

book_ref.quote: The cardiac portion is present immediately after oesophagus

blocks.prompt:
14 Name the layers of the stomach wall, including its three muscle layers.
(Stomach ki deewar ki tahein, us ki teen muscle tahon samait, likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Bahar se: serosa; smooth muscle ki teh (bahar longitudinal, darmiyan circular aur andar oblique muscles); submucosa; mucosa.

book_ref.quote: The outermost layer is serosa, the middle layer is made of smooth muscles

blocks.prompt:
15 What is pyrosis?
(Pyrosis kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pyrosis (heartburn) seene mein dard bhari jalan hai jo stomach se tezabi chyme ke oesophagus mein wapas aane se hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: this condition is known as pyrosis or heartburn

blocks.prompt:
16 Name the three secretory cells of a gastric gland and the secretion of each.
(Gastric gland ke teen kharij karne wale cells aur un ki ratoobat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Mucous cells: mucus jo stomach ki parat ko HCl aur enzymes se bachata hai. Parietal (oxyntic) cells: hydrochloric acid. Chief cells: enzyme pepsinogen.

book_ref.quote: Each gastric gland contains epithelial cells and three secretory cells

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between pepsinogen and pepsin.
(Pepsinogen aur pepsin mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pepsin pepsinogen ki active shakal hai.

book_ref.quote: The H⁺ ions of the HCl activate pepsinogen into pepsin

rows: Chief cells kharij karte hain
Stomach mein pepsinogen se banta hai
Ghair-active shakal
Active enzyme; HCl ke H⁺ ions se active hota hai
Proteins hazam nahi karta
Proteins ko polypeptides aur peptides mein torta hai

blocks.prompt:
18 What is the role of rennin in infants?
(Bachon mein rennin ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bachon ke gastric juice mein rennin zyada hota hai. Yeh doodh ke proteins jama deta hai aur doodh ko small intestine mein der se jane deta hai; is der se doosre enzymes doodh ke proteins hazam kar lete hain.

book_ref.quote: The delay enables other enzymes to digest the milk proteins

blocks.prompt:
19 How is the stomach mucosa protected from its own acid and pepsin?
(Stomach ki mucosa apne hi acid aur pepsin se kaise bachti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hifazat do tareeqon se: gaarha mucus (mucous cells ka) stomach ki andaruni satah dhakta hai aur bicarbonate acid ko neutral karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The mucosa of stomach is susceptible to damage from acid and pepsin if it had no protection

blocks.prompt:
20 Differentiate between gastrin and somatostatin.
(Gastrin aur somatostatin mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono gastric ratoobat control karne wale hormones hain.

book_ref.quote: Gastrin is carried by blood to the gastric glands where it stimulates them to produce and secrete more gastric juice

rows: Ghiza mein protein par stomach ki mucosa ke endocrine cells kharij karte hain
Ghiza stomach se small intestine mein jaye to kaam karta hai
Gastric glands se zyada gastric juice nikalwata hai
Hydrochloric acid ka nikalna rokta hai

blocks.prompt:
21 Which two factors stimulate more gastric secretion once food arrives in the stomach?
(Ghiza stomach mein pohanchne par kaun se do awamil zyada gastric ratoobat ubhaarte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stomach ka phailna aur gastric cheezon ka pH kam hona zyada ratoobat aur taqatwar sukarao ubhaarte hain.

book_ref.quote: the distension of stomach and decrease in the pH of the gastric contents stimulate more secretion

blocks.prompt:
22 Name the parts of the small intestine with their lengths.
(Small intestine ke hisson ke naam un ki lambai ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Duodenum: pehle 20-25 cm. Jejunum: duodenum ke baad taqreeban 2.4 m. Ileum: aakhri teen-paanchwan hissa, taqreeban 3.5 m. Poori small intestine taqreeban 6 m lambi aur 2-3 cm qutr ki hai.

book_ref.quote: Small intestine consists of three parts i.e., duodenum, jejunum and ileum

blocks.prompt:
23 How is trypsin formed and what does it digest?
(Trypsin kaise banta hai aur kya hazam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pancreatic juice mein ghair-active trypsinogen hota hai. Duodenum ki deewaron ka enzyme enterokinase ise trypsin banata hai jo proteins ko polypeptides mein torta hai.

book_ref.quote: Trypsinogen, which is in inactive form

blocks.prompt:
24 Name four enzymes of pancreatic juice and the action of each.
(Pancreatic juice ke chaar enzymes aur un ka amal likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pancreatic amylase: polysaccharides se maltose (balke glucose). Trypsin: proteins se polypeptides. Pancreatic lipase: lipids se glycerol aur fatty acids. Pancreatic nucleases: DNA aur RNA se nucleotides. (Chymotrypsin aur carboxypeptidase: proteins se chhote peptides aur amino acids.)

book_ref.quote: Pancreatic lipase, which digests lipids to glycerol and fatty acids

blocks.prompt:
25 Why cannot lipase readily attack fats without bile salts?
(Bile salts ke baghair lipase charbi par asaani se asar kyun nahi kar sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Charbi paani mein hal nahi hoti, is liye lipase is par asaani se asar nahi karta. Bile salts detergent ki tarah charbi ko qatron mein tor kar alag rakhte hain aur lipid hazam karne wale enzymes ko bari satah dete hain.

book_ref.quote: So, they cannot be attacked readily by lipase enzymes of pancreatic juice

blocks.prompt:
26 Name four enzymes of intestinal juice and the product of each.
(Intestinal juice ke chaar enzymes aur un ki paidawar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aminopeptidase: polypeptides se dipeptides. Erepsin: dipeptides se amino acids. Maltase: maltose se glucose. Sucrase: sucrose se glucose aur fructose. (Lactase: lactose se glucose aur galactose; lipase: fats se fatty acids aur glycerol.)

book_ref.quote: The walls of jejunum and ileum contain glands which secrete intestinal juice

blocks.prompt:
27 Differentiate between chyme and chyle.
(Chyme aur chyle mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono alimentary canal mein ghiza ki shaklein hain.

book_ref.quote: the chyme is converted into an alkaline emulsion, called chyle

rows: Stomach mein khane ke 3-4 ghante baad
Small intestine mein intestinal juice ke baad
Neem-maae tezabi gola
Alkaline emulsion

blocks.prompt:
28 Describe the structure of a villus.
(Villus ki banawat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Villus jejunum aur ileum ki gol tahon par ungli numa ubhaar hai. Is mein khoon ki baareek naaliyan aur lymph naali, lacteal, hain jo aik cell moti epithelium se dhaki hain jis ke cells par microvilli hain.

book_ref.quote: The total surface area of absorption becomes extraordinarily large due to villi and microvilli

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between the absorption of glucose and of fatty acids.
(Glucose aur fatty acids ke jazb mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono jejunum aur ileum ki villi ke epithelial cells mein jazb hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Simple sugars (e.g., glucose) and amino acids are absorbed by diffusion or active transport

rows: Diffusion ya active transport se jazb
Passive transport se jazb
Villi ki khoon ki naaliyon mein jate hain
Dobara triglycerides ban kar protein se chylomicrons; lacteals mein jate hain
Hepatic portal vein se liver tak
Thoracic lymphatic duct se khoon mein

blocks.prompt:
30 What happens to chylomicrons after they enter the bloodstream?
(Khoon mein jane ke baad chylomicrons ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khoon ke plasma ke enzymes chylomicrons ko wapas fats aur proteins mein torte hain. Fats aakhir fatty acids aur glycerol ban kar jism ke cells mein jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Blood plasma has enzymes which hydrolyse chylomicrons back into fats and proteins

blocks.prompt:
31 What is the caecum? Why is the appendix called vestigial?
(Caecum kya hai? Appendix ko vestigial kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Caecum large intestine se ileum aur colon ke darmiyan nikli band thaili hai. Is ke band sire se ungli numa vermiform appendix nikalta hai; insaani digestive system mein yeh koi kaam nahi karta, is liye vestigial hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a blind sac that projects from the area of large intestine between ileum and colon

blocks.prompt:
32 What is appendicitis? Why must an infected appendix be removed?
(Appendicitis kya hai? Infected appendix ko kyun nikalna zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Appendicitis appendix ki sozish hai, aam taur par bacterial infection se. Ise operation (appendicectomy) se nikalna zaroori hai warna yeh phat sakta hai aur sozish pet ki poori parat mein phail sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: It is usually due to bacterial infection

blocks.prompt:
33 What are faeces composed of?
(Faeces kin cheezon se bane hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Faeces woh fuzla hain jo colon ke paani jazb karne se sakht ho jata hai. In mein bohat se bacteria, na hazam hone wale paudon ke reshe (jaise cellulose), baqi na hazam ghiza, jhari hui mucosa ki cells, bile pigments aur paani hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These wastes products, called faeces, consist of a large number of bacteria

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between the internal and external anal sphincters.
(Andaruni aur bairooni anal sphincters mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Rectum ke aakhri sire par anus in do sphincters se ghira hai.

book_ref.quote: Anus is surrounded by two sphincters

rows: Smooth muscles se bana
Striated muscles se bana
Rectum phailne par khud-ba-khud dheela hota hai (reflex)
Baligh mein cerebral cortex shaoori taur par control karta hai

blocks.prompt:
35 What is the importance of bacteria living in the colon?
(Colon mein rehne wale bacteria ki kya ahmiyat hai?)
blocks.explanation: E. coli jaise bacteria colon mein rehte aur taqseem hote hain. Apne metabolism mein yeh amino acids aur vitamin K banate hain. Vitamin K, jo khoon jamne ke liye zaroori hai, large intestine se khoon mein jazb hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Many bacteria, for example E. coli, live and actively divide within colon

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between egestion in infants and in adults.
(Bachon aur baligh mein egestion mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh nervous aur muscular nashonuma ke do marahil hain.

book_ref.quote: In adults, egestion becomes voluntary as the cerebral cortex matures

rows: Ghair-ikhtiyari reflex
Ikhtiyari
Spinal cord ke zariye; dimagh ke unche markaz abhi poore nahi bane
Pukhta cerebral cortex control karta hai
Rectum phailne par andaruni anal sphincter khud dheela
Bairooni anal sphincter ko shaoori taur par rok ya shuru kiya jata hai

blocks.prompt:
37 Write four functions of the liver in digestion.
(Hazme mein liver ke chaar kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Liver bile banata hai jo charbi ko emulsify karti hai; small intestine se jazb ghizai ajza ko process karta hai; nuqsan-deh maaddon ko be-asar (detoxify) karta hai; proteins banata aur energy ke liye glycogen jama karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Bile emulsifies fats, making them easier to digest

blocks.prompt:
38 What is the role of the gallbladder? What are gall stones?
(Gallbladder ka kya kirdar hai? Gall stones kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gallbladder liver ki bile jama aur gaarhi karta hai aur ghiza small intestine mein aaye to bile duct se chhorta hai. Gall stones tab bante hain jab liver ka cholesterol gallbladder mein jam jaye; yeh bile ka nikalna rok sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: The gallbladder stores and concentrates bile produced by the liver

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between the exocrine and endocrine portions of the pancreas.
(Pancreas ke exocrine aur endocrine hisson mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pancreas bara gland hai jo stomach ke peeche duodenum ke mor mein hai.

book_ref.quote: It has exocrine and endocrine portions

rows: Naali wala
Be-naali
Pancreatic juice pancreatic duct mein jo duodenum mein khulti hai
Insulin aur glucagon extracellular fluid mein, phir capillaries mein
Juice mein har ghiza ke enzymes (trypsin, chymotrypsin, lipases, amylases, nucleases)
Hormones, hazme ke enzymes nahi

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between secretin and cholecystokinin.
(Secretin aur cholecystokinin mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono duodenum ki deewaron ke hormones hain jo pancreas se pancreatic juice nikalwate hain.

book_ref.quote: Similarly, the partially digested proteins and fats present in chyme stimulate the duodenal walls

rows: Chyme ki acidity duodenum ki deewar ko ubhaare to nikalta hai
Chyme ke juzvi hazam proteins aur fats duodenum ki deewar ko ubhaarein to nikalta hai
Pancreas se pancreatic juice nikalwata hai
Pancreas se pancreatic juice aur gallbladder se bile nikalwata hai

blocks.prompt:
41 Write four metabolic roles of the liver.
(Liver ke chaar metabolic kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh zaa'id glucose ko glycogen aur zaroorat par wapas glucose banata hai; charbi tor kar energy deta aur cholesterol aur lipoproteins banata hai; amino acids badalta aur nuqsan-deh ammonia ko urea banata hai; khoon se zehreele maadde, adwiyat aur alcohol tor kar nikalta hai (aur hormones control karta hai).

book_ref.quote: It breaks down and removes toxins, drugs, and alcohol from the blood

blocks.prompt:
42 Name four kinds of nutrients stored in the liver.
(Liver mein jama hone wale chaar qisam ke ghizai ajza ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Glucose (glycogen ki shakal mein); vitamins A, D, B₁₂ aur K; iron aur copper jaise minerals; aur fats aur charbi mein hal hone wale maadde. Jism ko energy ya tameeri maadde ki zaroorat ho to yeh chhore jate hain.

book_ref.quote: It stores excess nutrients from the food and releases them when the body needs energy or building materials
